yt.description:
Light from the Sun takes about 8 minutes 19 seconds to reach Earth (mean distance 1 AU). Computed from the speed of light.
Narration is AI-generated.

scenes.text: You're seeing the Sun 8 minutes late
scenes.narration: When you look at the Sun, you're seeing the past.

scenes.label: to reach your eyes
scenes.narration: Its light needs {c_say} to reach you.
The Sun is a hundred fifty million kilometers away. Light does three hundred thousand per second. That's about five hundred seconds.
Even the Moon you see is {c_moon_say} seconds old.
So how old is the light from the stars?
